name: MonarchRadioCardGroup
title: RadioCardGroup
summary: One choice shown as selectable cards, each with a title and an optional description, icon and meta text.
whenToUse: For one choice between a few options that need more than a label to compare, such as plans, shipping speeds or workspace types.
whenNotToUse: For a plain list of short options use MonarchRadioRow in a selectableGroup. For several choices at once use MonarchCheckboxRow. For two to five short options in one line use Material 3 segmented buttons.
api: @Composable fun <T> MonarchRadioCardGroup(options: List<MonarchRadioCardOption<T>>, selected: T?, onSelect: (T) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, columns: Int = 1, enabled: Boolean = true)
class MonarchRadioCardOption<out T>(value: T, title: String, description: String? = null, meta: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

options.name: options
options.description: The cards, in order: value, title, and optional description, meta text, icon and enabled.

options.name: selected
options.description: The value of the chosen card, or null for no choice yet.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with the value of the card the user chooses.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label of the group.

options.name: columns
options.description: Cards per row, from 1 to 3, on windows at least 640dp wide. Narrower windows and font scales of 1.5 or more use one column.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether any card can be chosen. MonarchRadioCardOption.enabled disables one card.

states.name: unselected
states.description: A surface-coloured card with the default border and an empty radio mark.

states.name: selected
states.description: The accent subtle fill, a 2dp accent strong border, the icon in the accent strong color and a filled radio mark.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The Material ripple over the card.

states.name: focused
states.description: The Monarch focus ring around the card.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The subtle background, the subtle border and the disabled text color, for one card or the whole group.

appearance: Cards have large corners. Unselected cards use the surface color and the default border; the selected card uses the accent subtle fill and a 2dp accent strong border; disabled cards use the subtle background, the subtle border and disabled text. Titles are in the default text color, descriptions and meta text in the muted color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web builds on its RadioGroup and shows a radio in each card, as Android does with the Material 3 RadioButton; iOS has no radio button and draws its own mark. The value is a generic T instead of the web's string. The web stacks to one column under 40rem of container width; Android uses the width given to the group (one column under 640dp) and also stacks at font scales of 1.5 and above, like iOS at the accessibility text sizes. The web's invalid state and form name are not offered. Icons are a slot because Monarch bundles no icons.
accessibility: The cards are in one selectableGroup, so TalkBack announces their position in the group.
Each card is one element with the RadioButton role: the title, the meta text and the description are read together, and the chosen card is read as selected.
The selection is also a filled radio mark and a heavier border, not color alone.
The whole card is the touch target and is at least 48dp high; it draws the Monarch focus ring.
The icon is hidden from TalkBack.
Text wraps at font scale 2.0, and the cards stack in one column from font scale 1.5.
edgeCases: Two options with the same value are both shown as selected; keep values unique.
Cards in one row take the height of the tallest card.
A selected value that is not in options leaves every card unselected.

examples.title: With meta and description
examples.template:
MonarchRadioCardGroup(
    options = listOf(
        MonarchRadioCardOption({{options.0.value}}, {{options.0.title}}, description = {{options.0.description}}, meta = {{options.0.meta}}),
        MonarchRadioCardOption({{options.1.value}}, {{options.1.title}}, description = {{options.1.description}}, meta = {{options.1.meta}}),
        MonarchRadioCardOption({{options.2.value}}, {{options.2.title}}, description = {{options.2.description}}, enabled = !{{options.2.disabled}}),
    ),
    selected = selected,
    onSelect = { selected = it },
    label = {{label}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchRadioCardGroup(
    options = listOf(
        MonarchRadioCardOption("standard", "Standard", description = "Arrives in 3 to 5 working days.", meta = "€4.90"),
        MonarchRadioCardOption("express", "Express", description = "Arrives the next working day.", meta = "€12.00"),
        MonarchRadioCardOption("pickup", "Pick up in store", description = "Not available for this order.", enabled = !true),
    ),
    selected = selected,
    onSelect = { selected = it },
    label = "Delivery",
)

examples.title: With icons, in columns on a wide window
examples.code:
MonarchRadioCardGroup(
    options = listOf(
        MonarchRadioCardOption(
            value = 1,
            title = "Standard",
            description = "3 to 5 days",
            icon = { Icon(SampleIcons.Send, contentDescription = null) },
        ),
        MonarchRadioCardOption(value = 2, title = "Express", description = "1 to 2 days"),
    ),
    selected = speed,
    onSelect = { speed = it },
    label = "Delivery",
    columns = 2,
)
